glosses: Causing vexation or annoyance; teasing; troublesome.

examples.text: Although this letter is vexatious, I must not forget that my little entertainment has brought me a visiter in the Marquess of Wentworthdale, on an errand of no small moment, as the Countess of Rotheles may soon learn, to her surprise, for I shall, probably, see him at the Opera to-night.
He leads a vexatious life.

glosses: Commenced for the purpose of giving trouble, without due cause.
